topic: Offline Capability Truth Audit and De-Claiming

claim_100_percent_airplane_navigability.original_m1_claim: 100% Core Atlas Navigability in Airplane Mode
claim_100_percent_airplane_navigability.correction: Reframed into 5 explicit operational tiers: BUNDLED_AND_GUARANTEED, PERSISTED_AFTER_USE, OPTIONAL_DOWNLOAD, NETWORK_REQUIRED, PROVIDER_DEPENDENT.

claim_fixed_250mb_cache.correction: Eliminated arbitrary 250 MB number; cache size deferred to measured production image weight budgets at M23.

claim_guaranteed_offline_basemap.correction: Explicitly stated that Google Maps SDK and MapKit do not guarantee offline basemap tiles unless provider caching or external offline areas are present.

claim_offline_ai.correction: Cloud AI is strictly unavailable offline; only deterministic logic compiled locally in the client can execute.
